title: Checking-a-name (transformer)
description: Input/output shape of checking-a-name: checking specialized to inspect a name. The subject is constrained to the name structure; the predicate is any record appropriate to checking names. Specializations further constrain the predicate.

subject.description: The name being checked. References the name JSON Schema by $ref.

predicate.description: The predicate the name is checked against. Specializations bind this to a specific schema.

output.description: A check-decision record per the parent checking transformer's output schema.
